summary: The note is a short encyclopedia-style entry describing Red Lion, an unincorporated community in New Castle County, Delaware, United States. It explains the community's location relative to nearby towns and state highways. The note is brief and gives no history, population, or other details.
one_line: Red Lion is an unincorporated community in New Castle County, Delaware, located at the junction of Routes 7 and 71.
key_facts: Red Lion is an unincorporated community in New Castle County, Delaware, United States.
Red Lion is located at the intersection of Delaware Route 7 and Delaware Route 71.
Red Lion lies northwest of Delaware City.
Red Lion lies southwest of New Castle.
Delaware Route 7 and Delaware Route 71 meet at Red Lion.
